_doc.purpose: Book NSpace mapping table — IRS form fid → Income-Statement Acct UAS path.
_doc.format: [ 'F###', '<Acct UAS>' ]   3-digit zero-padded fid; UAS is either a single COA acct (e.g. 'Acct.Rev.Rent') or a stmtIncomeStmt taxAggregate name prefixed 'IS.' (e.g. 'IS.net_income').
_doc.scope: Only fields that are sourced from the Income Statement appear here.  Profile-sourced and Balance-Sheet-sourced fields live in bookNS_Profile.json / bookNS_BS.json.  A single Acct may appear under multiple fids (e.g. Acct.Rev.Rent → F030,F032,F034,F230).
_doc.resolver: irsForm.savePDF() resolves each entry as follows:  acct startswith 'Acct.' → stmtIncomeStmt row Balance for that COA acct;  acct startswith 'IS.'   → stmtIncomeStmt.taxAggregates()[name];  acct startswith 'Profile.' → stmtProfile cell;  acct startswith 'BS.'   → stmtBalanceSheet.taxAggregates()[name].
_doc.perPartner: Sch_K1 entries are partnership-level totals.  irsForm.savePDF() multiplies them by partner.pct from llcOwners when emitting per-partner FILL pdfs.

_Form1065_IRS_RULE.rule: For a PURE RENTAL LLC, Form 1065 Page 1 Lines 1–23 MUST ALL BE $0. Rental income/expenses are PASSIVE — they NEVER appear on Page 1 Lines 1a–8 (income) or Lines 9–22 (deductions). Any mapping to F038–F056 is an IRS violation and has been intentionally removed.
_Form1065_IRS_RULE.correct_flow: Books → Form 8825 (per-property via _build_f8825_filldict) → Form 8825 Line 23 → Schedule K Line 2 → K-1 Box 2 (per partner × %). Form 1065 Page 1 Lines 1–23 remain blank ($0). Books → Schedule K Line 2 independently (IS.net_rental, Books-First per IRC §446+703).
_Form1065_IRS_RULE.cross_form_audit: LLCTaxAgent XF-R05 verifies Page 1 Lines 1–23 are all $0. XF-R02 verifies Form 8825 Line 23 == Schedule K Line 2 == IS.net_rental (both independently sourced from books).

_Form1065_field_notes.F228: Schedule M-1 Line 1 — Net income (loss) per books. Source: IS.net_income (book basis). Only populated if Schedules L/M-1/M-2 are required (gross ≥ $250K AND assets ≥ $1M).
_Form1065_field_notes.F230: Schedule K Line 2 — Net rental real estate income/loss. Source: IS.net_rental (Books-First per IRC §446+703). Cross-form audit (XF-R02) independently verifies this equals Form 8825 Line 23.
_Form1065_field_notes.F247: Schedule K Line 7 — Other income (loss). REMOVED 2026-06-30: W&B Group has no other income, capital gains, royalties, or portfolio income. Lines 3–11 must be blank for a rental-only LLC (IRS instructions: leave blank when no such income exists).
_Form1065_field_notes.F248: Schedule K Line 16d — Gross income/gain for AMT (AMTI adjustment). REMOVED 2026-06-30: Partnerships are not subject to corporate AMT. Depreciation adjustments for individual AMT (IRC §56) are computed on each partner’s personal return, not on Form 1065 Schedule K. Filing depreciation here would be incorrect for a partnership.
_Form1065_field_notes.F276: Schedule L — Interest income (asset line). Source: IS.interest_income. Only populated if Schedule L is required.
_Form1065_field_notes.F279: Schedule K Line 19a — Cash distributions. REMOVED from active mappings (2026-06-14): stmtIS.taxAggregates() always returns distributions_cash=0.0 because cash distributions do not appear on the Income Statement. Correct source is GL Capital.Dist entries (books-first per IRC §446+§703). Leave blank until actual distributions are booked to Acct.Equity.Owner.Capital.Dist. KD-R04 diagnostic will catch any stale value.
_Form1065_field_notes.F281: Schedule M-1 related — income reconciliation. Source: IS.interest_income. Verify exact line in namespace.
_Form1065_field_notes.F410: Schedule L end-of-year balance. Source: IS.net_income (book net income for equity calculation). Only if Schedule L required.
_Form1065_field_notes.F429: Schedule M-2 — Partners' capital accounts. Source: IS.net_income (allocated income per IRC §705). Only if Schedule M-2 required.

_Sch_K1_field_notes.F049: K-1 Box 1 — Ordinary business income/loss. MUST be $0 for rental LLC (IRC §469(c)(2)). Always Val.0.
_Sch_K1_field_notes.F050: K-1 Box 2 — Net rental real estate income/loss. Source: IS.net_rental × partner.pct at runtime. ONLY income box for a rental LLC.
_Sch_K1_field_notes.F055: K-1 Box 5 — Interest income. Source: IS.interest_income × partner.pct at runtime.
_Sch_K1_field_notes.F077: K-1 Box 14a — SE earnings. MUST be $0 for rental LLC (IRC §1402(a)(1)). Always Val.0.
_Sch_K1_field_notes.F098: K-1 Box 19a — Cash distributions. Source: IS.distributions_cash (actual per-partner amount, NOT multiplied by pct).

_Sch_K1_note: Runtime values are provided by _buildFillDict() in Sch_K1.py which multiplies by partner.pct and keys by namespace fid directly. Entries above are documentation-only; they are NOT resolved by stmtIS_Tax.loadFillDict() at runtime.

_Form8825_doc.runtime: Form8825 is NOT resolved via this static bookNS. stmtIS_Tax.loadFillDict('Form8825') calls _build_f8825_filldict() which builds the fill dict dynamically from GL records grouped by propNm. This section is DOCUMENTATION ONLY.
_Form8825_doc.cip_rule: CIP properties (Acct.Fixed.Tangible.InConstruction, no placed-in-service date) are excluded from Form 8825 entirely. IRC §168(a): MACRS starts at placed-in-service. Pre-service expenses must be capitalized (IRC §263(a)), not reported on Form 8825.

RV_RV1_2025.status: InConstruction — Bill of Sale 2025-12-29. Not placed in service.
RV_RV1_2025.form_8825_column: NONE — excluded. No income, no expenses, no depreciation on Form 8825.
RV_RV1_2025.pre_service_expenses: Acct.Exp.Repair + Acct.Exp.Other entries for RV_RV1 (~$1,075) MUST be reclassified to Acct.Fixed.Tangible.InConstruction. IRC §263(a): capitalize all pre-placed-in-service costs.
RV_RV1_2025.irc_authority: IRC §168(a) (no depr until in service); IRC §263(a) (capitalize construction costs); Reg. §1.263(a)-2(a)
